newsitem.title: PERU: Peru detains six government workers in drugs probe.
newsitem.headline: Peru detains six government workers in drugs probe.

text.p: Peruvian police have detained six foreign ministry workers over the smuggling of two pounds (900 grams) of cocaine sent in a diplomatic bag to the country's U.N. mission, police sources said on Wednesday.

The police took action after the government said Monday that diplomats at the United Nations found a package containing cocaine addressed to a Peruvian civil servant in New York from a former foreign ministry worker.
The sources gave no further details of the case, another potential embarrassment to President Alberto Fujimori after a series of drugs scandals last year.

In 1996, bags of cocaine were discovered on two Peruvian navy ships and on an air force jet used by the president. A captured drug baron also alleged Fujimori's top security adviser gave protection to drug smugglers.
Peru is the world's largest producer of coca leaves, the raw material for cocaine.
